lines.t: In the rust of the Emperor's yard...
Dawn breaks cold on row three-eighteen
Tarp on the gravel, the toolbag's clean
Last six of the VIN carved into my sheet
A thousand dead machines lie at my feet
Sockets ring like battle bells
I strip the bones of iron shells
Junkyard Hero! Wrench in hand
Lord of the scrap in a broken land
Pull it, pack it, list it, ship
Sold to the void with a five-star tip
Junkyard Hero! Grease and flame
Seventy-five an hour is the name of the game
Sensors and switches, relics of old
Throttle and actuator, worth more than gold
No core, no cracked case, no dead mechanism
I serve the Machine God of eBay's algorithm
Comps like scripture, sold not asked
Every part a holy task
Junkyard Hero! Wrench in hand
Lord of the scrap in a broken land
Pull it, pack it, list it, ship
Sold to the void with a five-star tip
Junkyard Hero! Grease and flame
Seventy-five an hour is the name of the game
Do you want to live forever?
Rise again from the rubble and rain
The spirit calls, the hero stands
Back to the yard, back to the chain
Bubble mailer! Box it tight!
Ship by noon! Pull tonight!
Bubble mailer! Box it tight!
For the Emperor of Resale... fight!
Junkyard Hero! Wrench in hand
Lord of the scrap in a broken land
Pull it, pack it, list it, ship
Sold to the void with a five-star tip
Junkyard Hero! Grease and flame
Seventy-five an hour is the name of the game
In the rust of the Emperor's yard...
The Junkyard Hero never dies
